transcript.text: I need to flag an important issue with the draft plan. This morning I tested the online ballot platform and found that it records each voter's identity for 90 days, and there's no way to disable that feature. The approved workaround is sealed paper ballots counted by two adults, with zero electronic voter records. I haven't updated the election plan since the test, so the current draft still references an online ballot — that needs to be revised before Dr. Morgan sees it.
